SELECT audit_item.targetType, audit_item.targetId, audit_item.feedbackId, audit_item.userId, COALESCE(NULLIF(author.realname, ''), author.username) AS userName, audit_item.title, audit_item.content, audit_item.parentId, audit_item.official, audit_item.auditStatus, audit_item.auditReason, audit_item.auditedBy, COALESCE(NULLIF(auditor.realname, ''), auditor.username) AS auditorName, audit_item.auditedAt, audit_item.createdAt FROM ( SELECT 'feedback' AS targetType, f.id AS targetId, f.id AS feedbackId, f.user_id AS userId, f.title AS title, f.content AS content, NULL AS parentId, 0 AS official, f.audit_status AS auditStatus, f.audit_reason AS auditReason, f.audited_by AS auditedBy, f.audited_at AS auditedAt, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM ts_feedback f WHERE f.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'comment' AS targetType, c.id AS targetId, c.feedback_id AS feedbackId, c.user_id AS userId, NULL AS title, c.content AS content, c.parent_id AS parentId, c.is_official AS official, c.audit_status AS auditStatus, c.audit_reason AS auditReason, c.audited_by AS auditedBy, c.audited_at AS auditedAt, c.created_at AS createdAt FROM ts_feedback_comment c WHERE c.is_deleted = 0
UNION ALL
SELECT 'append' AS targetType, a.id AS targetId, a.feedback_id AS feedbackId, a.user_id AS userId, NULL AS title, a.content AS content, NULL AS parentId, 0 AS official, a.audit_status AS auditStatus, a.audit_reason AS auditReason, a.audited_by AS auditedBy, a.audited_at AS auditedAt, a.created_at AS createdAt FROM ts_feedback_append a WHERE a.is_deleted = 0 ) audit_item LEFT JOIN sys_user author ON author.id = audit_item.userId LEFT JOIN sys_user auditor ON auditor.id = audit_item.auditedBy WHERE 1 = 1
AND audit_item.targetType = #{query.targetType}
AND audit_item.auditStatus = #{query.auditStatus}
AND ( audit_item.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR audit_item.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR author.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR author.realname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY audit_item.createdAt DESC, audit_item.targetId DESC
SELECT * FROM ts_feedback WHERE id = #{targetId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ts_feedback_comment WHERE id = #{targetId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM ts_feedback_append WHERE id = #{targetId} AND is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE
